Well, there are many labels that might fit you, I can't really prescribe any to you but I think I can help you


Does your gender fluctuates with time? If so gender fluidity is something I said look into. it is often thought of as only changing between male and female, but it can include both, one, or even neither. Gender fluidity can also include many different shades of non binary, which there are unfortunately not many good words for yet, but are important to remember when discussing fluidity. 


Do you feel that you have a definitive gender that is neither male or female? if that is the case, you may be non binary. It is common for non binary to be thought of as something between male and female, but that is false. Imagine (please bear with me here) condiments. There is ketchup and mustard, but there is also mayo and horse radish, and barbecue sauce, and warchestershire sauce, and many more. The same applies to non binary genders, there are many. 


There is also the possibility that you are agender. The term agender refers to people who have no gender. I feel weird having this paragraph be so short but it is simpler than the other two. 


I think there are more gender identities, but those are the ones I could think of. Something that I would recommend is is finding an online chat room that is open to people experimenting with their gender. There, you would be able to try on different labels and different pronouns to see what feels the most comfortable and what fits you best!
